title: Quadratic Characterizations for Reachability Analysis of Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.20482v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quadratic constraints (QCs) are widely used to characterize nonlinearities and uncertainties, but generic analytical characterizations can be conservative on bounded domains. This paper develops a framework for constructing verified quadratic characterizations of scalar relations in the two-dimensional real plane. Candidate quadratic inequalities are locally generated by solving convex quadratic programs using samples from the relation and exterior sample points. They are then verified globally using sum-of-squares certificates over an exact semialgebraic description or, in the case of nonpolynomial relations, over relaxed polynomial descriptions. The resulting verified constraints define a sound overapproximation of the scalar relations over the considered domains. translated_title: 面向神经网络可达性分析的二次型刻画方法
translated_abstract: 二次约束被广泛用于刻画非线性特性与不确定性，但通用的解析刻画在有限域上可能过于保守。本文提出了一个用于构建二维实平面上标量关系的经验证的二次型刻画框架。候选二次不等式通过求解凸二次规划在局部生成，利用了来自该关系的样本点以及外部样本点；随后借助平方和证书，在精确半代数描述上进行全局验证，对于非多项式关系，则在松弛的多项式描述上进行验证。由此得到的经验证约束在所考虑的域上定义了标量关系的可靠过近似。这些约束与现有的基于二次约束和逐点积分二次约束的静态非线性分析框架直接兼容。
tldr: 本文提出一个通过凸二次规划局部生成候选二次不等式、再用平方和证书全局验证的框架，为二维平面上的标量关系构建可靠过近似的二次刻画，可直接应用于基于二次约束和积分二次约束的神经网络可达性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a framework that locally generates candidate quadratic inequalities via convex quadratic programs and globally verifies them with sum-of-squares certificates, yielding sound overapproximations of scalar relations that are directly compatible with QC- and IQC-based neural network reachability analysis.
